mapper.select: SELECT o.*, u.name as user_name, u.phone as user_phone, c.name as course_name, c.price as course_price FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN course c ON o.course_id = c.id WHERE u.phone = #{phone} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order` (order_number, user_id, course_id, amount, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderNumber}, #{userId}, #{courseId}, #{amount}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
